Target (yellow L): rows 45-53, cols 51-59

- Need to move DOWN 3 rows (from row 42 to row 45)
- Need to move RIGHT 30 columns (from col 21 to col 51)
But moving RIGHT 30 columns would cause multiple swaps with the charcoal F. Let me think about the swap behavior:
- When black F crosses charcoal F moving LEFT, they swap
- When black F crosses charcoal F moving RIGHT, they also swap
So if I move the black F RIGHT, it will cross the charcoal F and they'll swap. Then the black F will be on the right side of the charcoal F.
Let me try moving the black F RIGHT to get to the yellow L's column. I'll need to move RIGHT about 30 columns.
Actually, wait. Let me reconsider. The black F is 8 columns wide (cols 21-29). The yellow L is 8 columns wide (cols 51-59). So to align them, I need to move the black F RIGHT by 30 columns (from col 21 to col 51).
But the charcoal F is at cols 33-41, which is in the way. If I move the black F RIGHT, it will cross the charcoal F and they'll swap. After the swap, the black F will be at cols 33-41 and the charcoal F will be at cols 21-29.
Then I can continue moving RIGHT. But wait, after the swap, the black F is at cols 33-41 and the charcoal F is at cols 21-29. If I continue moving RIGHT, the black F will move away from the charcoal F, no more swaps.
So the plan is:
1. Move RIGHT until the black F crosses the charcoal F (they swap)
2. Continue moving RIGHT until the black F reaches cols 51-59
3. Move DOWN 3 rows to reach rows 45-53
Let me try this. The black F is at cols 21-29 and the charcoal F is at cols 33-41. To cross the charcoal F, I need to move RIGHT until the black F's right edge (col 29) passes the charcoal F's left edge (col 33). That's 4 columns.
After moving RIGHT 4 times, the black F will be at cols 25-33, which overlaps with the charcoal F at cols 33-41. This should trigger a swap.
After the swap, the black F will be at cols 33-41 (where the charcoal F was) and the charcoal F will be at cols 25-33 (where the black F was).
Then I need to move RIGHT 18 more times to get from cols 33-41 to cols 51-59.
